refusal_label.instructions: What does this refused request most need from Circuit OS?

criteria.range_widen_existing: An existing function refused on range; widen an envelope.
criteria.industrial_io: 24 V inputs, 4-20 mA, 0-10 V or relay I/O.
criteria.out_of_scope: Switching converters, PCB-only or free-form requests.
criteria.none_of_these: None of the above; a human should extend the label set.
